items.x: The Leonida Keys are a string of islands in the south of the state, linked by bridges and roads built over the water. Rockstar describes a life there that moves to the rhythm of the sea, between fishing, marinas, beach bars and some occasional smuggling, far from the bustle of Vice City. items.t: Mount Kalaga National Park — GTA VI
items.x: Mount Kalaga National Park covers the north of the state, right up against the border. It’s the only real high ground in Leonida: pine forests, gorges, rivers and waterways running down to the swamps. Rockstar presents it as the place people come to hunt, fish, camp and go off-road, away from the bustle of the cities. Official screenshots there show enduro bikes and quads in the mud, a helicopter over the ridges, hunters in the undergrowth and a kayak under a railroad bridge.

items.x: A sprawling metropolis in southern Leonida, Vice City is home to pastel art deco hotels, clubs where celebrities hang out and the world’s largest cruise port. items.x: The tools save their data in your browser’s storage (localStorage, and sessionStorage for what is cleared when the tab closes). All keys start with “lk”. Nothing is written until you do something: a key appears with your first action (a number entered, a box checked, a draft, a selection, a question to Léo). Tracking and Progress: what you checked off (vehicles, weapons, gear, lists), and your progress.
